name: Adni
long_description:
Adni is the career community for 200,000+ nurses and allied health workers. Members use our app to chat with career coaches, apply for jobs, store credentials, connect with recruiters, find meetups, and shop for gear.

Organizations partner with Adni to reach and hire healthcare workers through our network, a verified database of 2.4M clinicians, and AI-powered marketing tools. Customers have received 67,000+ clinician leads and acquire clinicians at 3x lower cost.

Customers include Massachusetts General Hospital, Penn Medicine, ChristianaCare, Medical Solutions, Medline, Jaanuu, Proliability, and more.

Founded by two nurses. Backed by YC, Flare Capital, Liquid 2, Fresco, Augment, Crista Galli, Adam Grant, and the founders of CareRev, Clipboard Health, and Papa.
one_liner: The career community for healthcare workers
